description: This file defines the 'App' class for the Slim PHP framework, which manages application initialization, middleware management, routing, and request handling. It implements core functionality to run the web application within the framework.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Core application class for Slim framework, managing middleware, routing, and request processing.

methods.name: getRouteResolver
methods.description: Returns the route resolver instance used by the application.

methods.name: getMiddlewareDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the middleware dispatcher managing middleware stack.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds middleware to the middleware dispatcher stack; accepts middleware as class, string, or callable.

methods.name: addMiddleware
methods.description: Adds a MiddlewareInterface instance to the middleware stack.

methods.name: addRoutingMiddleware
methods.description: Adds built-in routing middleware to the stack for handling route dispatching.

methods.name: addErrorMiddleware
methods.description: Adds Slim's error handling middleware with configuration options.

methods.name: addBodyParsingMiddleware
methods.description: Adds body parsing middleware to handle request body parsing.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the application, handling the incoming request and emitting the response.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles a request through the middleware stack and produces a response.
